headline: ARI @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.58 at TEX 4.07, with a projected total of 7.65. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved +0.07 runs while TEX moved -0.70, changing the projected margin by +0.77 runs. The projected total fell -0.64, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Nathan Eovaldi has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Ildemaro Vargas, Lourdes Gurriel Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Jose Fernandez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
